items.title: The combined medication approach for treating overactive bladder: assessing safety and efficacy
items.summary: Research question: What is the latest evidence on the efficacy and safety of combining medications to treat overactive bladder? The problem: Overactive bladder symptoms negatively impact quality of life and, with an ageing population, overactive bladder prevalence is expected to rise.

items.title: Ontex handed £8.48m interim All-Wales continence contract after NHS Wales missed its own extension deadline
items.summary: NHS Wales Shared Services Partnership has direct-awarded Ontex Healthcare UK an interim contract worth £8.48m, for an initial six months with an option to extend for a further six, to keep supplying continence products to every Welsh health board and trust.

items.title: Children as young as 13 seen by NHS for bladder damage caused by ketamine
items.summary: Children as young as 13 for bladder problems associated with ketamine use according to doctors who set up an NHS clinic to manage the problem.
